spec_type_rationale: add a search box to the widget catalog page
overview: Add a keyword search box to the widget catalog page so shoppers can filter the widget list by name and tag.
current_state: The widget catalog page renders the full widget list with no filtering. Widgets are loaded once on page mount.
desired_behavior: The catalog page shows a search box. Typing filters the widget list by name and tag in real time. Clearing the box restores the full list.

affected_areas.impact: add search input and client-side filter

acceptance_criteria.statement: The catalog page shall render a search input element.
The catalog shall still list every widget when the search box is empty.
acceptance_criteria.verification_command: the unfiltered list length equals the widget count

acceptance_criteria.statement: WHEN the shopper types a keyword, the list shall show only widgets whose name or tag contains it.
The build pipeline shall run the catalog component tests.
acceptance_criteria.verification_command: ci config runs the widget test suite

acceptance_criteria.statement: IF the search box is cleared, THEN the full widget list shall be restored.
acceptance_criteria.verification_command: clearing the box restores all widgets

acceptance_criteria.statement: The catalog page help text shall describe the search box.
The widget list shall contain no duplicate widget entries after filtering.
acceptance_criteria.verification_command: filtered list has no duplicate ids

constraints.content: Filter on the client; do not add a new backend endpoint.
Filtering must update the list within 100ms for up to 500 widgets.

risks.risk: Large catalogs make client-side filtering janky
risks.mitigation: Debounce input and cap rendered rows

risks.risk: Tag field missing on legacy widgets breaks tag matching
risks.mitigation: Treat an absent tag as an empty string
